title: MSFS Marketplace just added these 4 airports - worth it?
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for April 26, 2026 is packed with must-have new releases for PC simmers, featuring highly anticipated international airports like Porto and Oslo alongside immersive new regional sceneries you’ll want in your hangar. In this video, we dive deep into the regional upgrades that just dropped, specifically focusing on the massive improvements over default scenery in the UK and USA.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Fly X Simulations: EGAC Belfast City Airport (Detailed Northern Ireland hub with full terminal interior)
🛫 UK2000 Scenery: KCON Concord Airport (Essential New Hampshire GA hub with military static aircraft)
🛫 MSFScenery Builders: KFMN Four Corners Regional (New Mexico regional airport with custom tower modeling)
🛫 Spinoza: KWWD Cape May Airport (Featuring the Naval Air Station Wildwood Aviation Museum)

🕒 Chapters

✈️ See you in the skies!
